detailed_descriptions.en: Control Davy, the weakest zombie imaginable, and battle through a mysterious dungeon to defeat KOM, the King of Monsters. Every dive makes Davy grow stronger faster. Customize his body, devour powerful monsters, steal their abilities, and race against time to conquer the dungeon. Created by GPTRACK50, a studio founded by veteran action game developers, Stupid Never Dies is a unique single-player 3D action RPG combining fast-paced growth, bizarre humor, and stylish action. Davy, a timid zombie, falls in love at first sight with Julia, a college girl frozen to death during the Great War. To bring her back to life, he must defeat KOM, recover humanity’s lost knowledge, and survive the dungeon’s deadly depths. Can the weakest zombie save the girl he loves—and maybe the world? Defeat elite monsters, consume their cores, and steal their powers. Transform into 11 unique Styles, including Werewolf, Harpy, Golem, Vampire, and more. Replace Davy’s body parts with powerful Overtech gear to boost stats and unlock new Active and Passive Skills. Fight your way with endless build combinations. Unleash Davy’s imagination to temporarily transform reality and dramatically boost all of his abilities. Battle classic monsters enhanced by Overtech, including werewolves, vampires, harpies, lizardmen, and more. Different weapons, armor, and abilities make every encounter fresh and unpredictable. Davy The weakest zombie in existence. Mocked by monsters and humans alike, he enters the dungeon to save Julia and prove himself. Julia A college student who died inside a shopping mall freezer during the Great War. Davy falls in love the moment he finds her. Dr. Frank A brilliant but obsessive scientist who guides Davy’s journey while pursuing his own ambitions.
